title: Predicting immobilized-HCAb IL-2 response from sequence and binding

cases.study_information: The source study describes humanized anti-CD3 HCAbs tested in plate-immobilized-antibody Jurkat activation and flow-cytometry binding assays. The variable-domain sequence is supplied for each candidate. Binding is reported as Jurkat CD3-positive fluorescence intensity (MFI); no CD3-negative measurement is supplied. The activation endpoint is IL-2 concentration in pg/mL. The humanized HCAbs were yeast-produced. The exact antibody coating concentration is not reported in the source. Predict the withheld IL-2 response under this source-described assay; this endpoint does not represent soluble-antibody autonomous activation or a clinical cytokine-release estimate.

output_format: One comma-separated line containing every target exactly once, in the requested order; no explanation.
material_context: Yeast-produced humanized HCAbs for both binding (Example15 exception to Example5) and activation (Examples13/7)
